abstract: Cryptorchid testis have a greater risk of malignant change than do normally descended testis. The undescended testis would also be susceptible to torsion by the mechanism of increase in testicular size. A 36-year-old man of torsion of malignant undescended testis is presented. He was diagnosed as having incarcerated inguinal hernia on his first visit to general surgeon due to acute left lower abdominal pain. At laparotomy, a 7.5 x 5.5 x 3.0 cm3, greyish tan color mass was found. The pathological diagnosis is choricarcinoma and teratoma, mixed germ cell tumor. We would emphasise that in any patient presenting with acute abdominal symptoms and an absent scrotal testis, the possibility of a complication of torsion of undescended testis should be considered.
abstract_ja: 停留精巣は正常に下降した精巣よりも悪性化のリスクが高い。停留精巣は、精巣サイズの増大機序により捻転を起こしやすい。36歳男性が急性の左下腹部痛で一般外科を初診し、嵌頓鼠径ヘルニアと診断された。開腹術で7.5×5.5×3.0 cm³の灰褐色の腫瘤が認められた。病理診断は絨毛癌と奇形腫の混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。急性腹症を呈し陰嚢内に精巣を触れない患者では、停留精巣の捻転による合併症の可能性を考慮すべきであると強調したい。
